responsibility: Declares the full FIO buffered file I/O API, exporting the abstract FIO_File handle type, predefined standard streams, and the file-opening, buffered read/write, character, string, binary cardinal, positioning, filename-query, and flush operations used throughout the GNU Modula-2 boot runtime. It is the principal public contract for file-handle based I/O, distinct from the simpler standard-stream IO layer and the dynamic-string SFIO wrapper.
same_name_distinction: This header is the public API surface for FIO, declaring the abstract FIO_File type, standard stream globals, and buffered file operations. Unlike gcc/m2/pge-boot/GFIO.cc, it does not define the per-file state structures or implement buffering and descriptor management.
